craft_notes: Sthāyin: irregularity. Rows: examples roll. Read aloud: loose file.

lines: But the feastly, though he lodge in the teaching, keeps no calendar —
master's coming, his feast, wisdom's day — so some.
l4.sanskrit_cite: naimittikaṃ tu tacchāsanasthānām api aniyatam tadyathā gurutadvargāgamanaṃ tatparvadinaṃ jñānalābhadinam ityādikam iti kecit
